name: Tectova Runway Records
description: The runway record of the fashion industry, for AI agents. Look up models' runway careers, show casts, fashion-house histories and models by country at each fashion week. Read-only, no API key; every answer links back to tectova.com.
author: Tectova

tools.name: search_fashion_records
tools.description: Find models, creatives, fashion houses and agencies on Tectova's runway record. Use this first to resolve a name to a slug.

tools.name: get_talent_runway_record
tools.description: A model's or creative's documented runway record on Tectova: Big Four runway count, seasons, first and latest season, top houses, per-season rows, agencies on record, honours and the people they work with most. Input a talent slug from search_fashion_records.

tools.name: get_show_cast
tools.description: The documented cast of one runway show on Tectova: house, season, city, date where on record, collection design credits and the models with their Tectova pages, 50 per page. Input a show path from get_brand_runway_history or get_talent_runway_record.

tools.name: get_brand_runway_history
tools.description: A fashion house's documented runway history on Tectova: show counts, the faces of the house and its shows with a cast register, newest first, 25 per page. Input a brand slug from search_fashion_records.

tools.name: get_country_talent
tools.description: Models of one nationality on Tectova's Big Four runway record, mirroring the site's three country pages. Country alone: the most cast, the last five seasons, models new to the circuit, season by season, the houses and casting directors that cast them most. Add city: that fashion week across every season since 2002. Add city and season: every model there that season, their shows, who opened or closed a show and who was new to the city. Answers questions such as "Which Chinese models walked New York Fashion Week this season?"
